about:
Crypton Mills at Broad River operates in Cliffside, North Carolina, on the site of the former Abercrombie Textiles mill. The company continues a longstanding textile tradition in the region, though a specific founding date is not publicly disclosed. Ownership details and founder names have not been shared.

The mill weaves American-made textiles for residential and contract markets, offering customized yarn development, performance capabilities, and creative design services. Its team includes weavers, designers, and customer service specialists who collaborate on textile solutions. The facility leverages a rich textile legacy with modern innovations, though no facility size, headcount, or production volumes are published.

Customers include residential and contract sectors, such as furniture, hospitality, and healthcare interiors. The company positions its products for both home and commercial applications, focusing on textile solutions that make an impact.

Crypton Mills emphasizes its rich textile legacy combined with innovation, aiming to deliver high-standard products with quick lead times. The differentiation rests on domestic manufacturing, custom yarns, and performance-focused textiles.
